text.p: Mexican steelmaker Hylsamex SA de CV approved a dividend payment of 0.64 peso per outstanding share, a company executive told a news conference on Monday.

"Following a general shareholders' assembly, a dividend payment of 64 centavos per share was approved which totals 156 million pesos. Lump sum payments will be made on April 7," said Hylsamex Executive Director General Alejandro Barragan.
Hylsamex also unveiled details of its 1996 sales and volumes at the assembly.
Barragan said the company sold 2.5 million tonnes of steel in 1996, or 16 percent more than in 1995, which brought revenues to 9.679 billion pesos, an increase of nine percent from year-ago figures.
Hylsamex exported 21 percent of its total production, which earned the company $212 million. Export sales are expected to account for 18 percent of total sales in 1997, Barragan added.
